newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE SAYS GREW FASTEST IN EAST EUROPE IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE SAYS GREW FASTEST IN EAST EUROPE IN 1996.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange, which launched its delayed official index on Wednesday, said the new market indicator showed the Latvian bourse had the biggest growth in 1996 in eastern Europe.

The Riga bourse index has risen to 379.98 from its initial value of 100 points on April 2, 1996, when it was first calculated. The bourse's market capitalisation rose to 157.43 million lats against 29 million lats in June 1996.

"According to comparative data of the European Federation of Stock Exchanges, the Latvian bourse registered the biggest growth in eastern Europe in 1996," bourse president Uldis Cerps told a news conference.
"Investors who invested a year and a half ago have seen a return on equity of 300 percent and 150 percent for those who invested a year ago," he added.
